# app-agents

Agents for apps — installable, composable, and named after the app they are
expert in.

```bash
npx @app-agents/cli search snapchat
npx @app-agents/cli add snapchat-ads
```

New here: read [the repo README](https://github.com/app-agents/agents#readme),
the [naming rule](https://github.com/app-agents/agents/blob/main/docs/naming.md),
or [add an app](https://github.com/app-agents/agents/blob/main/docs/adding-an-agent.md).

Not affiliated with or endorsed by any app vendor covered by these packages.
